
```{r}
set.seed(0703)
# Loading in data, then changing Conc. to SampleID so all the same columns are included in both sets
kh_clinical_data = read.csv("kh_clinical_processed.csv")
recombinant_training_data = read.csv("dab18_combined_augment_outlier_removed_median_subtracted.csv")
recombinant_training_data = recombinant_training_data %>% rename(SampleID = Conc.) %>% 
  select(-cAb13)
  
recombinant_training_folds = vfold_cv(recombinant_training_data, strata = target_vector, repeats = 2)

train_rec_no_preproc = recipe(target_vector~., data = recombinant_training_data) %>% 
  update_role(Replicate, SampleID, new_role = 'id')

train_rec_normalized = recipe(target_vector~., data = recombinant_training_data) %>% 
  update_role(Replicate, SampleID, new_role = 'id') %>% 
  step_normalize(all_predictors())

kh_clinical_data
recombinant_training_data
```

```{r}
# Set up model parameters and workflow objects
# Model parameters
svm_r_spec = svm_rbf(cost = tune(), rbf_sigma = tune()) %>% 
  set_engine('kernlab') %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

svm_p_spec = svm_poly(cost = tune(), degree = tune()) %>% 
  set_engine("kernlab") %>% 
  set_mode("classification")

nnet_spec = mlp(hidden_units = tune(), penalty = tune(), epoch = tune()) %>% 
  set_engine('nnet', MaxNWts = 2600) %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

qda_spec = discrim_quad() %>% 
  set_engine('MASS') %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

bag_cart_spec = bag_tree() %>% 
  set_engine('rpart', times = 50L) %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

rf_spec = rand_forest(mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), trees = 1000) %>% 
  set_engine('ranger') %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

xgb_spec = boost_tree(tree_depth = tune(), learn_rate = tune(), loss_reduction = tune(), 
              min_n = tune(), sample_size = tune(), trees = tune()) %>% 
  set_engine('xgboost') %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

# Update some parameters that need to see the data first
nnet_param = 
  nnet_spec %>% 
  extract_parameter_set_dials() %>% 
  update(hidden_units = hidden_units(c(1, 27)))

rf_params = rf_spec %>% 
  extract_parameter_set_dials() %>% 
  update(mtry = mtry(c(1, 10)))

# Generate workflow sets
normalized_wfs = workflow_set(
  preproc = list(normalized = train_rec_normalized),
  models = list(SVM_radial = svm_r_spec, 
                SVM_poly = svm_p_spec, 
                neural_network = nnet_spec,
                QDA = qda_spec)
  )
normalized_wfs = normalized_wfs %>% option_add(param_info = nnet_param, id = 'normalized_neural_network')

no_preproc_wfs = workflow_set(
  preproc = list(simple = train_rec_no_preproc),
  models = list(CART_bagged = bag_cart_spec,
                RF = rf_spec, boosting = xgb_spec)
)

no_preproc_wfs = no_preproc_wfs %>% option_add(param_info = rf_params, id = 'simple_RF')

```

```{r}
# Bundle workflow
all_workflows = 
  bind_rows(no_preproc_wfs, normalized_wfs) %>% 
  mutate(wflow_id = gsub("(simple_)|(normalized_)", "", wflow_id))

# Set up training control
grid_ctrl = control_grid(
  save_pred = TRUE,
  parallel_over = "everything",
  save_workflow = TRUE
)

grid_results = all_workflows %>% 
  workflow_map(
    seed = 0703,
    resamples = recombinant_training_folds,
    grid = 25,
    control = grid_ctrl
  )

for (val in 1:11){
  print(grid_results[val,]$result)
}
```
```{r}
autoplot(grid_results,
         rank_metric = 'roc_auc',
         metric = 'roc_auc',
         select_best = TRUE # Returns one point per workflow
         ) + 
  geom_text(aes(y = mean - 0.05, label = wflow_id), angle = 90, hjust = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(y = mean + 0.05, label = round(mean, 3))) +
  lims(y=c(0, 1)) +
  theme(legend.position = 'none')

autoplot(grid_results,
         rank_metric = 'accuracy',
         metric = 'accuracy',
         select_best = TRUE # Returns one point per workflow
         ) + 
  geom_text(aes(y = mean - 0.05, label = wflow_id), angle = 90, hjust = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(y = mean + 0.05, label = round(mean, 3))) +
  lims(y=c(0, 1)) +
  theme(legend.position = 'none')


autoplot(grid_results,
         id  = 'neural_network',
         metric = 'roc_auc')
```

```{r}
# Extracting fitted workflows. With access to a fitted resample object (really 
# the results of a tune grid), I can use fit_best() to obtain a fitted object
# with which I can predict the test set using
best_nn_fit = grid_results %>% 
  extract_workflow_set_result("neural_network") %>% 
  fit_best(metric = 'roc_auc')

best_nn_preds = predict(best_nn_fit, kh_clinical_data)
best_nn_preds
sum(kh_clinical_data$target_vector == best_nn_preds$.pred_class)/length(best_nn_preds$.pred_class) 

nn_predictions = bind_cols('true_class' = kh_clinical_data$target_vector, "prediction" = best_nn_preds)
nn_predictions$.pred_class = droplevels(nn_predictions$.pred_class )
nn_predictions
caret::confusionMatrix(as.factor(nn_predictions$true_class), nn_predictions$.pred_class)
```
```{r}
best_rf_fit = grid_results %>% 
  extract_workflow_set_result("RF") %>% 
  fit_best(metric = 'roc_auc')

best_rf_preds = predict(best_rf_fit, kh_clinical_data)
sum(kh_clinical_data$target_vector == best_rf_preds$.pred_class)/length(best_rf_preds$.pred_class) 

rf_predictions = bind_cols('true_class' = kh_clinical_data$target_vector, "prediction" = best_rf_preds)
rf_predictions$.pred_class = droplevels(rf_predictions$.pred_class )
levels(rf_predictions$.pred_class)
caret::confusionMatrix(reference = as.factor(rf_predictions$true_class), data = rf_predictions$.pred_class)
```
